class.name: BulletSplitStage2D
class.brief_description: One generation of a split chain: when a bullet splits and what its children do.
class.description: A bullet that dies by one of the enabled triggers bursts into [member count] children at its pose: ONE new volley of exactly [member count] bullets per parent. Children copy the parent's spawn data (or [member child_data]); without [member child_data] the data's per-bullet arrays are left out (their entries index the parent's volley) and every child takes its parent bullet's own per-bullet values instead (spin, gravity, curves, wobble). Direction comes from [member direction_mode], speed from [member speed_mode]; the Keep group decides what else the children inherit. Every accepted change emits [code]changed[/code]; volleys read the stage when a bullet dies, so edits reach bullets in flight. Bad values are refused with an error and the old value is kept.

method.name: child_angle_radians
method.description: The direction of child [param child_index] of [param children], in radians relative to the reference direction (the parent's heading, or the world's +X), for the unit rolls [param random_roll] (Random In Spread) and [param jitter_roll] (0.5 = no jitter). Use it to preview a split.

method.name: child_speed_multiplier
method.description: The speed multiplier of child [param child_index] of [param children] for the unit roll [param random_roll] (used by the Random distribution).

members.member: Each child turns by a random angle up to this many degrees either way (0 = none, up to 360).
Turns the whole pattern: the fan's center, the ring's first child.
The odds that a bullet splits when a trigger fires (0 to 1). Manual splits ignore it.

Spawn data for the children instead of the parent's. Its per-bullet arrays index the children (entry [code]k[/code] drives child [code]k[/code]). Grandchildren copy it too unless their stage has its own.
How many children each parent becomes (1 up to the pattern limit, [code]BulletPatterns2D.max_bullets_per_pattern[/code]; a limit lowered later caps it).
How the children spread out (see [enum DirectionMode]).
When on, a splitting bullet also fires its normal death effects and sounds (On Destroy, On Lifetime Over, On Clear, On Despawn) besides On Split. Off: only On Split.
The children's speed in Fixed mode (times their multiplier). Shown only in Fixed mode.
When on, the children also carry the parent volley's inherited momentum (a moving spawner's velocity).
When on, children start with their parent's hit count (they may die on their first hit); off, they start at 0.
When on, every child carries its parent bullet's custom data (the same resource).
When on, the children fly in their parent's flock.
When on, the children keep their parent's graze zones and graze targets.

When on, children home like their parent: a live owner spawner with homing on aims them like a fresh shot (its homing signals fire), otherwise they chase the parent's current target. Off: they fly straight.
When on, the children keep their parent's sound effects.

How many times one bullet may split in one life, counted over every trigger (0 = no limit; the spawner warns about an unlimited survivor). Only matters with [member parent_survives]: a bullet that left splitting and was woken again ([method BulletVolley2D.enable_bullet]) splits again. Manual splits ignore it. Hidden while [member parent_survives] is off.

When on, a split that does not kill the bullet (bounce, survived hit, homing reached, graze, the [member split_after_sec] timer, a manual split) adds the children and the parent keeps flying, splitting again on later triggers up to [member max_splits_per_bullet]. Deaths (killing hit, lifetime, despawn, clear) always take the parent. Off: the children replace the parent (it leaves without death effects of its own; On Split fires).
When on, directions are measured from the parent's flight heading; off, from the world's +X axis.
The children's size relative to the parent (must be greater than 0).

0 = Godot's global random numbers. Any other value makes the random parts (chance, Random In Spread, jitter, Random speed) a pure function of the seed, the generation and the parent bullet's index: a seeded stage splits a given bullet the same way every time.
Children start this far from the parent's position, each along its own direction (0 = all on the parent's position).
How the children's multipliers spread between min and max (see [enum SpeedDistribution]).
Where the children's speed comes from (see [enum SpeedMode]).
The largest speed multiplier (min and max are sorted when used, never refused against each other).
The smallest speed multiplier.

Seconds after the volley spawned when every live bullet of the volley splits by itself (0 = off). The volley clock: the whole volley splits together, once per life. The bullets keep flying with [member parent_survives].
Split when the bullet bounces (after the bounce handler, at the bounced pose: the children fan around the new heading). The parent stays only with [member parent_survives].
Split when cleared ([method BulletVolley2D.clear_bullet], area clears, factory clears). Off by default. Resets, frees and pickup conversions never split.
Split when leaving the factory's despawn bounds. Off by default.
Split when the bullet grazes a target (one split per graze event, after the graze handlers). The parent stays only with [member parent_survives].
Split when a hit kills the bullet (decided after the hit handler: a heal vetoes the split too).

Split when the bullet reaches its homing target (after the reached handler). Turn [member keep_homing] off for children that should scatter instead of chasing the same target. The parent stays only with [member parent_survives].
Split when the lifetime runs out (an extension from the [code]life_time_over[/code] handler vetoes it).
Split on every counted hit the bullet survives (piercing bullets that shed children). The killing hit is [member split_on_hit]. The parent stays only with [member parent_survives].
The angle the children cover in Fan and Random In Spread modes (0 to 360). Hidden in Ring mode.

constants.constant: Evenly across [member spread_degrees], centered on [member angle_offset_degrees].
360 / [member count] degrees apart, the first child at [member angle_offset_degrees].
A random angle per child within [member spread_degrees] around [member angle_offset_degrees].
The parent's current speed, top speed and acceleration, times the child's multiplier.
[member fixed_speed] times the child's multiplier (top speed and acceleration from the spawn data).
The children's spawn data speed, times the child's multiplier (without [member child_data]: the data's shared speed).
From [member speed_multiplier_min] (first child) to [member speed_multiplier_max] (last child).
A random multiplier per child between min and max.
